PM Modi Marks 25 Years in Government with Temple Visit

Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Shri Vinayak Mandir in New Delhi's Sarojini Nagar on Wednesday to offer prayers to Lord Ganesha. This visit marked his completion of 25 years as the head of a government.
